title: Cap. X open: our sentence on reprobation is set forth and confirmed — after weighing adversaries, what our view is and on what stays it rests
pass_a_gloss: CHAPTER X. Our sentence concerning Reprobation is set forth and confirmed. Thus far we have weighed the sentence and arguments of the Adversaries. Now let us see what our sentence concerning reprobation is, and upon what stays it rests.
pass_b_english: CHAPTER X. Our sentence on Reprobation is set forth and confirmed. Thus far we have weighed the adversaries' view and arguments. Now let us see what our view of reprobation is, and on what stays it rests.
source_text: CAP. X. Nostra de Reprobatione sententia exponitur et confirmatur. Hactenus Adversariorum sententiam et argumenta expendimus. Jam quae sit nostra de reprobatione sententia, quibusque firmamentis nitatur, videamus.
notes: Densify De praedestinatione Cap. IX Arg. 14 Sol close / Cap. X open section 695. Pass A!=B. Packet praedestinatione_cap9_arg14_solclose_densify.
